India Approves Over ₹1.25 Lakh Crore for Semiconductor Mission 2.0

An Expenditure Finance Committee has cleared an outlay of ₹1.25 lakh crore for the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0. This initiative aims to boost domestic chip manufacturing and design capabilities. The plan now awaits approval from the Union Cabinet.
